_comment: One entry per operating mode: LOW_ENERGY, CRITICAL_TASK1, CRITICAL_TASK2, BOTH_CRITICAL. variant0/cores0/l1_0/v0 = ImageClassification (Task 2); variant1/cores1/l1_1/v1 = ImageClassification2 (Task 1) -- a second, distinctly-named copy of the SAME ResNet8Tiny/ResNet20 models/weights, needed because DynMultiDeeploy's C-symbol prefixing is derived from variant name + core count, and LOW_ENERGY/BOTH_CRITICAL both split 4/4, which would otherwise make Task1 and Task2 resolve to the literal same prefix.
